title: Study of Oral Deucrictibant XR Tablet for Prophylaxis and Deucrictibant Soft Capsule for On-Demand Treatment of Angioedema Attacks in Adults With Acquired Angioedema Due to C1 Inhibitor Deficiency
off: A Phase 3, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled, 3-Part Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Orally Administered Deucrictibant XR Tablet for Prophylaxis and Deucrictibant Soft Capsule for On-demand Treatment of Angioedema Attacks in Adults With Acquired Angioedema Due to C1 Inhibitor Deficiency
conds: Acquired Angioedema Due to C1-Inhibitor Deficiency (AAE-C1-INH)
summary: This is a Phase 3, multicenter, 3-part study, with 2 randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled parts and an open-label extension part, to evaluate the efficacy and safety of orally administered deucrictibant XR tablet for prophylaxis, and deucrictibant soft capsule for on-demand treatment of angioedema attacks in adult participants aged ≥ 18 years with AAE-C1INH.
desc: The study consists of a Screening Period, during which eligibility is confirmed, a Part 1 Prophylaxis Double-blind Treatment Phase, a Part 2 On-demand, Double-blind Treatment Phase, and a Part 3 On-demand Open-label Extension Phase. Approximately 24 participants will be randomized in Part 1 into 2 parallel arms for a treatment period of 12 weeks. During the prophylaxis treatment period participants will receive blinded study drug (deucrictibant 40 mg XR or placebo randomized in a 1:1 ratio). Upon completion of Part 1, participants will roll-over into Part 2. In addition to rollover participants completing Part 1, new deucrictibant treatment-naïve participants will be enrolled directly into Part 2 and this may occur while Part 1 is ongoing. During the on-demand period participants will receive blinded study drug (deucrictibant 20 mg soft capsule or matching placebo randomized in a 1:1 ratio, 2-period, 2-treatment crossover design) for 2 qualifying AAE-C1INH attacks. Participants completing Part 2 may roll over into Part 3 where all AAE-C1INH attacks will be treated with open-label deucrictibant 20 mg soft capsule.
elig:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Provision of written informed consent
* Male or female (sex at birth) aged ≥18 years
* Diagnosis of AAE-C1INH
* History of AAE-C1INH attacks prior to the Screening Visit.
* If underlying disease associated with AAE is present, the underlying disease must be stable throughout the duration of part 1.
* Reliable access and ability to use available therapy to effectively manage AAE- C1INH attacks.
* Female participants of childbearing potential must agree to the protocol-specified pregnancy testing and to be abstinent from heterosexual intercourse or to use an acceptable contraception method.

Females of non-childbearing potential (surgically sterile, or postmenopausal with ≥ 12 months amenorrhea and postmenopausal FSH confirmation) are not required to use contraception during the study.

• Capable of recording, without assistance, eDiary and ePRO data using an electronic device, as evidenced by the eDiary and ePRO training.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Participation in a clinical study with any other investigational drug within the last 30 days or within 5 half-lives of the investigational drug at the Screening Visit (whichever is longer).
* Receiving long-term prophylaxis (LTP) treatment for AAE-C1INH and satisfied with this treatment. Participants who are not satisfied (eg, tolerability issues, lack of efficacy) and have previously stopped LTP treatment for AAE-C1INH, for reasons other than participation in this study, can sign the ICF and begin the Screening Period only if their last dose of the treatment was received prior to the timepoint before the Screening Visit
* Any females who are pregnant, plan to become pregnant, or are currently breast-feeding
* Abnormal hepatic function
* Moderate or severe renal impairment
* Any clinically significant comorbidity or systemic dysfunction that would interfere with the participant's safety or ability to participate in the study.
* History of epilepsy and/or other significant neurological diseases
* Any clinically significant and uncontrolled gastrointestinal dysfunction that may impact study drug absorption
* Evidence of current alcohol or drug abuse
* Use of medications that are moderate and strong inhibitors of cytochrome P450 (CYP) 3A4, or strong inducers of CYP3A4 within the last 30 days or within 5 half-lives (whichever is longer) at the time of the Screening Visit
* Known hypersensitivity to deucrictibant or any of the excipients of the study drug
* Use of angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors or any estrogen-containing medications with systemic absorption within 5 half-lives before the Screening Visit

x.titre: Deucrictibant oral en prophylaxie et à la demande dans l'angiœdème acquis par déficit en C1-INH
x.question: Le deucrictibant, en prophylaxie et en traitement de crise, est-il efficace et sûr dans l'angiœdème acquis par déficit en inhibiteur de la C1 ?
x.contexte:
L'angiœdème acquis par déficit en inhibiteur de la C1 estérase (AAE-C1INH) est une maladie très rare de l'adulte. Il est le plus souvent associé à un lymphome B, à une hémopathie lymphoïde ou à une maladie auto-immune, avec consommation du C1-INH. Il provoque des crises d'œdème similaires à celles de l'angiœdème héréditaire, médiées par la bradykinine. Les options disponibles sont peu nombreuses et peu étudiées par des essais contrôlés ; les médicaments utilisés (C1-INH, icatibant, acide tranexamique, androgènes) viennent souvent de l'AOH.

Le deucrictibant est un antagoniste oral du récepteur B2 de la bradykinine. La forme à libération prolongée (XR) sert à la prophylaxie, la capsule molle au traitement des crises. L'étude de phase 3 comporte trois parties. La partie 1 est randomisée en double aveugle contre placebo pour la prophylaxie. La partie 2 évalue la capsule molle en traitement de crise, contre placebo. La partie 3 est une extension ouverte. Le promoteur est Pharvaris, avec des centres en France.
x.interet: L'étude cible une maladie sans traitement spécifiquement validé et pourrait offrir une option orale pour la prophylaxie et les crises. Elle pourrait aussi aider à mieux caractériser l'effet des antagonistes B2 hors AOH héréditaire.
x.profil: Des adultes (≥ 18 ans) atteints d'angiœdème acquis par déficit en inhibiteur de la C1 et ayant déjà eu des crises.
inclusion: Diagnostic d'AAE-C1INH avec antécédent de crises
Maladie sous-jacente éventuelle stable pendant la partie 1
Accès fiable à un traitement de crise efficace
Capacité à renseigner seul un journal électronique et des questionnaires
Contraception et tests de grossesse pour les femmes en âge de procréer
exclusion: Autre médicament expérimental dans les 30 jours ou 5 demi-vies
Traitement de fond de l'AAE-C1INH en cours et jugé satisfaisant
Grossesse, désir de grossesse ou allaitement
Anomalie hépatique, insuffisance rénale modérée ou sévère
Antécédent d'épilepsie ou de maladie neurologique significative
Dysfonction digestive non contrôlée pouvant gêner l'absorption, consommation d'alcool ou de drogues

x.critere: Partie 1 : nombre de crises confirmées par l'investigateur, normalisé par le temps, sur 12 semaines. Partie 2 : délai de soulagement des symptômes (impression globale « mieux » au moins) dans les 12 heures. Partie 3 : événements indésirables.
